question: How is the half-woman-lord described in relation to the auspicious form thus and so?
premises: of the auspicious form is indicated
inference: Thus, in relation to the auspicious form, the half-woman-lord is described so.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic role of kalyāṇamūrtestu is unclear from this verse alone.
plain_english: Thus, of the auspicious form, the half-woman-lord so.
